bear_assumptions: Apply 25x USD 10.50 normalized forward EPS as semiconductor-equipment growth slows, China and export controls constrain sales, customer concentration reduces bargaining power, investment and inventory absorb cash, and the premium multiple compresses.
base_assumptions: Apply 32x USD 13.00 forward EPS as leading-edge logic, DRAM, advanced packaging and AGS growth persist, Q3 guidance broadly converts, margins remain strong, and cash conversion normalizes without removing policy or cyclicality risk.
bull_assumptions: Apply 40x USD 16.00 forward EPS as AI infrastructure drives sustained above-cycle equipment demand, product leadership expands share, EPIC partnerships accelerate commercialization, margins rise, and export-control and supply constraints remain manageable.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if price or higher primary-evidence earnings make expected return, base return, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, margin of safety, confidence, and an accepted relationship clear every canonical gate; downgrade if leading-edge or DRAM demand weakens, AGS growth stalls, gross margin reverses, free-cash-flow conversion remains weak, export restrictions intensify, or customer concentration causes material volatility.
